From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Gordon <alyssa.gordon@ecosphere.cloud>, Mark Patel <mark.patel@integralgsi.com>

Date: Wed, 22 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Ecosphere partner playbook — sync on partner-led tech deep dive windows

Hi Alyssa / Mark —

Thanks again for the discovery earlier today — great to learn more about Ecosphere's marketplace onboarding model and where a Redwood-powered inference path could help reduce token cost and demo latency for your ISV partners. Quick recap from our side and suggested next steps: 

Recap / key needs we heard:
- Marketplace integration: a lightweight listing + usage metering (no vendor-managed infra needed initially)
- Security: SSO + per-account audit logs, potential need for dedicated VPC for high-volume sellers
- Latency SLO: conversational demos must be under 350ms 95th on our sample dataset
- Validation: partner-run technical deep dive to test quantized variants and prefix caching behavior

Proposed next step: partner-led technical deep dive (90 minutes) where Redwood infra and an Ecosphere integrator run a sandbox demo, validate perf, and confirm rollout constraints. Could Mark from IntegralGSI join to outline integration responsibilities?

Suggested windows (Pacific TZ):
- Tue 28 May: 09:30–11:00 PT
- Wed 29 May: 13:00–14:30 PT
- Thu 30 May: 10:00–11:30 PT

Please confirm which window works for you, and list any extra attendees (cloud ops / procurement / integrator tech lead). I've attached a one-pager with scope and a sample agenda. I can also spin up a short mutual action plan doc after we lock a slot.

Attaching: Redwood_Ecosphere_onepager.pdf (1 page)

Thanks — looking forward to locking dates.

— Rachel
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Strategic Partners
Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

- We need to test with a small public dataset and our sample token shape; I attached our vendor requirements workbook with the expected payload shapes and telemetry keys
- Procurement will join if we cover pricing and billing model briefly (10 minutes)

Availability (PT) — all windows below work for us, prefer shorter-morning slots:
- Wed 29 May: 08:30–10:00 PT
- Thu 30 May: 09:30–11:00 PT

If Wed 29 08:30 works, Mark / Sara / our Cloud Ops lead can join. Otherwise Thu 30 09:30 is our second pick.
